vbaReview: Dynamic arrays require explicit local Dim declarations; scalar-only, one-dimensional arrays remain enforced.
ReDim bounds evaluate once, left-to-right and within signed32-bit/per-array/aggregate limits.
Preserve retains matching lower bound and copies the bounded overlap; work includes allocation, retirement, and copying.
Erase distinguishes fixed reset from dynamic deallocation and releases string occupancy consistently.
For Each locks are released on normal completion, loop exit, and exceptional unwinding; nested locks remain counted independently.
Procedure return restores caller allocation/string quotas; array parameters and global arrays remain outside this dialect.
